question_text: A 23-year-old college student presents with his parents for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and was started on risperidone approx. 2 months ago. He reports a significant improvement since the start of treatment. His parents report that their son’s symptoms of delusions, hallucinations, and paranoid behavior have been ameliorated. On physical examination, the patient seems uncomfortable. He frequently fidgets and repeatedly crosses and uncrosses his legs. When asked if something is troubling him, he gets up and starts pacing. He says, “It’s always like this. I cannot sit still. It is frustrating.” What is the most likely diagnosis?
